notes.title: Update for players requests
notes.notes:
Hello Players,

First of all, we want to sincerely apologize.

We’re aware that some players had a frustrating experience during the early stages of our game. We're truly sorry for that. We're a small team of just two people at Lunart Team, doing our best to create something meaningful — but there were moments where we fell short, and we take full responsibility for it.

We’re carefully listening to all your feedback and working hard to improve the game. We’re learning from our mistakes and making steady progress to provide a better experience for everyone.

Your support and patience mean a lot to us. Thank you.

— Lunart Team
